## NEW CONTEXT 2026-08-24 — Cursor is a founding TSC member of Agent Plugins 1.0
Cursor sits on the Agent Plugins Technical Steering Committee (with AWS, Microsoft, OpenAI, Vercel)
and is a named implementing client, alongside ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Kiro and VS Code. The
Aug 19 "custom modes for skills" line is Cursor's side of that ecosystem. The Agent Toolkit for AWS
ships plugins for Cursor specifically. => Cursor's marketplace is NOT the only way extensions reach
a Cursor install; a plugin authored anywhere in the ecosystem is portable to it, and the
`aws configure agent-toolkit` wizard installs into detected agents' config directories directly.
See agent-plugins_spec.txt.
